Build prompt

Build “Farmers Market Booth Inventory & Cash Tally” on NeoApps for a farmers market vendor. Capture opening stock, sales and counted cash by booth and show closing variances. Limit records and exported data to the owning team. Include a demo with fictional records.

Acceptance test

Start with 30 jars, sell 8 at $5 cash and count $38 of sales cash. Show 22 jars and a $2 shortfall.
